caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard or credenza with a reddish-brown finish. The furniture has four slender, tapered legs with straight lines, and the top surface features a gentle serpentine or bow-front curve. The piece includes multiple drawers: two large drawers on the left, three smaller drawers in a vertical stack on the right, and two narrower drawers above and between the sets of large drawers. Each drawer is fitted with oval, gold-colored handles and small keyholes. There is a semi-circular cutout or arch at the bottom center of the sideboard, creating an open space beneath the drawers. The drawing is rendered with visible shading to suggest depth and the texture of wood grain, and it is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Sideboard
